SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE created_date IS NULL
           OR BTRIM(created_date::text) = ''
    ) AS missing_created_date,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE problem IS NULL
           OR BTRIM(problem::text) = ''
    ) AS missing_problem,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE city IS NULL
           OR BTRIM(city::text) = ''
    ) AS missing_city,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE closed_date IS NULL
           OR BTRIM(closed_date::text) = ''
    ) AS missing_closed_date,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE latitude IS NULL
           OR longitude IS NULL
    ) AS missing_coordinates,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
           OR longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180
    ) AS invalid_coordinates

FROM public.urban_service_requests;
